post.summary: Verify registration and revoke prior sessions
post.description: CSRF header required. Library performs protocol/cryptographic verification; 64 KiB maximum body. Invalid responses consume the challenge. Commits public key, revocation cutoff, family revocation, logout outbox and audit atomically. In optional REQUIRED mode, verified hardware attestation, current signed metadata/status, explicit CA trust and a device-bound credential are required; no new identity assurance claim is issued.
